Research Interests

text:
Work Experience

Risk Analyst — goeasy
August 2026 – Present

Evaluated the sensitivity of a machine learning risk model to missing data by designing and running a series of robustness tests.
Translated technical findings into clear recommendations for non-technical stakeholders.



Research Assistant II — McMaster University
May 2026 – June 2026

Accelerated MCMC sampling algorithms through vectorization and C++ implementations, reducing computation time.
Designed and ran simulation studies extending thesis research to evaluate method performance.
Developed the core of an open-source statistical software package, scheduled for public release by the end of 2026.



Teaching Assistant — McMaster University
September 2024 – December 2025

Supported three statistics courses: Intermediate Probability Theory, Statistical Methods and Applications, and Linear Regression.
Assessed upper-year probability proofs for correctness, rigour, and clarity.
Mentored first-year students in the Math Help Centre on calculus, linear algebra, probability, programming, and proofs.



Student Intern, IT & Data Operations — Sodexo Canada
March 2020 – August 2022

Analyzed telecom contract and operational cost data to identify savings opportunities, contributing to over $50,000 in reductions; built dashboards in Smartsheet to visualize project progress and present findings to leadership; managed structured data tracking across Canada-wide hardware deployments and asset management initiatives.

Behold your luck! It seems that you have managed to find your way to my little site. I’m a statistician applying to PhD programs, and this is where you can get to know me a little better.




Master’s in Statistics, McMaster University (2026), supervised by Dr. Pratheepa Jeganathan. My thesis studied how shrinkage priors and identification constraints interact in Bayesian factor models. I presented it at the 2026 SSC Annual Meeting, and a paper is in preparation for Computational Statistics and Data Analysis.
First paper, Counterexample to Continuity of Measure in Uncountable Unions, with Dr. Noah Forman, accepted in Examples and Counterexamples.
Teaching: gave a set of lectures on martingales in a graduate stochastic processes course, and worked as a TA for three statistics courses.
Now: Risk Analyst at goeasy.

More details are on my Education & Experience and Projects pages.



Applied probability, particularly the ideas behind computational statistics and Bayesian nonparametrics.



A PhD where I can learn new concepts, develop my own, and share that knowledge with others, followed by a faculty career doing research in applied probability and teaching.



E-mail me at 1simranbilkhu@gmail.com, or find me on GitHub and LinkedIn.

title: Projects
text:
Talks and Presentations


Poster · SSC Annual Meeting · June 2026

A Comparative Study of Bayesian Factor Models under PLT and UGLT Identification Constraints
Presented my thesis research in the Student Research Poster Presentation Competition.



Talk · April 2025

Sparse Bayesian Factor Analysis when the Number of Factors is Unknown
A review of Frühwirth-Schnatter et al. (Bayesian Analysis, 2025), covering spike-and-slab priors, shrinkage priors and UGLT structures.



Talk

Reversible Jump MCMC
Background on reversible jump MCMC for models where the number of parameters is itself unknown.



Talk · January 2025

Sparse Principal Component Analysis
Links between factor analysis and PCA, and a simulation comparison of sparse PCA against varimax rotation.



Talk · September 2024

Hamiltonian Monte Carlo
A conceptual and mathematical overview of HMC, plus a co-developed Shiny app for sampling with it.

title: Projects
text:
Modelling


Data Science · Winter 2025

Impacts of Diet Intervention on the Gut Microbiome
PCA and model-based clustering of microbiome counts with 1400+ features to compare plant- and animal-based diets.



Data Science · December 2024

Spatio-Temporal Analysis of Bird Migration
A spatio-temporal mixed model cut test error from 1,377 to 31 compared with ridge-penalised Poisson regression.



Data Science · November 2024

Establishing Baseline Climate Partitions via Clustering
K-means and agglomerative clustering of Canadian climate rasters, with the number of clusters chosen by silhouette analysis.



Data Science · September 2024

Expansion of Canadian Agriculture and the Relationship with Wetlands in Boreal Shield Provinces
66 satellite land-cover maps analysed in R, with a Shiny app to explore provincial trends.

title: Projects
text:
Probability Theory and Stochastic Processes


Lecture · July 2025

Martingales and Related Processes
Notes for a lecture I gave on martingales and their relationships to Markov, Wiener and Poisson processes, with an introduction to stochastic kernels.

title: Projects
text:
Bayesian Nonparametrics


Proof · Winter 2025

From the CRP to the GEM Distribution
A detailed proof that the proportions from the Chinese Restaurant Process converge in distribution to the GEM distribution.



Proof · Winter 2025

Size-Biased Permutations of the Poisson–Dirichlet Distribution
Showing that the size-biased permutation of the two-parameter Poisson–Dirichlet distribution is the two-parameter GEM distribution.
